# The Neural Swarm guide teaches a renderer the hero no longer mounts

Follow-up of #21568, blocked by it. Self-assigned; no curated labels, because the rewrite needs the scene its builder just wrote and is dated by the Engine 14 cut.

## Context

The pull request for #21568 deletes `apps/portal/canvas/HomeCanvas.mjs` (the "Neural Swarm") and mounts `Neo.canvas.RoundTable` in the Portal's hero. `learn/guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm.md` is a guide about the deleted renderer. That pull request leaves `learn/` alone on purpose: a guide is rewritten at the guide-authoring bar, not as a side effect of a code change.

## The Problem

`learn/guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm.md` (164 lines, written under `#8680` in January 2026) opens with *'The "Neural Swarm" (Home Hero Canvas) is more than just a background effect'* and teaches the "Autonomous Simulation" pattern on it: 150 nodes, 20 agents, typed-array buffers, boids, flow fields, shockwaves. Once #21568 merges, the Home Hero Canvas is something else and the guide's specimen exists only in history. A reader who follows the guide into the Portal finds no such code.

## The Architectural Reality

- The guide: `learn/guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm.md`; its entry `learn/tree.json:128` ("Neural Swarm (Autonomous Simulation)", id `guides/advanced/NeuralSwarm`).
- `learn/guides/advanced/NeuralFabric.md:5` opens by contrasting itself with it.
- `apps/portal/llms.txt:401`, `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` carry the guide through their generators (`buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`, `buildScripts/docs/seo/`), never by hand.
- The successor specimen: `src/canvas/RoundTable.mjs` with its host `src/app/roundtable/Canvas.mjs`. What it teaches that the swarm did not: a frame as a function of a record and a clock (nothing accumulates, so the replay loops and tests exactly), a scene that lays itself out around a statement its host measures, erasing under that statement, a still frame for reduced motion, a buffer at the host's pixel ratio. What both teach: typed arrays read per frame, a renderer on the canvas worker behind `Neo.app.SharedCanvas`.

## The Fix

Rewrite the guide for the round table, as the pattern guide for a record-driven scene on the canvas worker, with code blocks taken from the merged source. Decided at intake (2026-11-20): a new id, `guides/advanced/RoundTable`, and the old one removed. A file named after the swarm that teaches the round table would mislead every later reader, and no guide has a redirect stub to follow. `tree.json` changes in the same commit, and the generator writes `llms.txt` and `seo.json`. Prescription checked: `learn/guides/advanced/` — owns the concern (the pattern guides for the Portal's other canvases live there; `CanvasArchitecture.md` teaches effects driven by input, not a replayed record). `NeuralFabric.md:5` then names the successor. Retiring the guide without a successor is the fallback only if the rewrite does not reach the bar before the cut; it loses the Portal's one guide about a simulation on the canvas worker.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1.** No guide under `learn/` presents the Home hero canvas as the Neural Swarm or teaches code that is not in the tree: `git grep -n "Neural Swarm\|NeuralSwarm" -- learn/guides` names only the successor's own history line, if any.
- [ ] **AC-2.** Every code block of the successor guide is merged source, cut, never retyped: from `src/canvas/RoundTable.mjs`, `src/app/roundtable/Canvas.mjs`, the Portal's hero that consumes them (`apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/`), the header of `buildScripts/docs/recordWeek.mjs` or the scene's unit spec. The PR names the commit they were taken at and each block's source lines. (Sharpened at intake: a guide that shows how a consumer names its statement and its palette needs the consumer's two files.)
- [ ] **AC-3.** `learn/tree.json` carries the guide's id and title, `llms.txt` and `seo.json` carry them from `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`, and `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` and `npm run check-relative-links` pass. (Sharpened at intake: the sitemap in the tree is the corpus pipeline's output, 78,772 lines against a 630-line engine-only render, so it is not regenerated here; see Post-Merge Validation.)
- [ ] **AC-4.** `NeuralFabric.md` names the successor where it named the swarm.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] On the deployed site after the Engine 14 cut: `/learn/guides/advanced/RoundTable` answers 200, the served sitemap and `llms.txt` name it, and neither names `NeuralSwarm`. The author's, with the walk of Mon 23 Nov.

## Out of Scope

The Neural Timeline and Neural Fabric guides beyond that one sentence. Blog posts and release notes that mention the swarm: they are history. The round table itself (#21568) and its second consumer in `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Keeping the deleted renderer as an example so the guide stays true.** The operator called both swarm-style canvases below the bar (2026-11-20, quoted in #21568); an example that exists for a guide's sake is dead code with a reader.
- **Editing `llms.txt` or `seo.json` by hand.** They are generated.
